_meta.source: MOE post secondary admissions pages, MOE press releases on admission criteria changes for the first SEC cohort, ITE and polytechnic admissions pages
_meta.notes: Criteria apply to the first SEC cohort entering post secondary in 2028, admitted through the PSE (one exercise replacing the JAE, PFP and DPP exercises). Figures marked confirmed were corroborated against extracts of the primary MOE, SEAB and ITE pages plus two or more independent sources on 2026-08-05; the session could not open the primary pages end to end, so eyeball them once before students use this. Revised 2026-10-27 from search engine extracts of the MOE PSE pages: JC and MI need all five L1R4 subjects at G3; polytechnic B2 counts at its G2 equivalent; 3 year Higher Nitec is graded at G1; LASALLE and NAFA ask for G3 English. Structural rules are evaluated by the app. Performance rules are shown, and computed only from grades a student chooses to enter as targets.

destinations.name: Junior College
destinations.feels: Fast and essay heavy. I narrow to a few subjects and go deep.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: L1 is English or Higher Mother Tongue; English must also reach C6.

structural.label: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3
structural.move: Take Mathematics, or Additional Mathematics, at G3
structural.note: A G3 Mathematics at D7 or better is a grade floor.

structural.label: A Humanities subject at G3
structural.move: Take a Humanities subject at G3
structural.note: R1 is a Humanities subject. Which arts subjects count is read from older JAE lists.

structural.label: Three G3s in Humanities, Maths, Science
structural.move: Take a third Humanities, Maths or Science subject at G3
structural.note: R1, R2 and R3 of L1R4: a Humanities, a Maths or Science, and one more of either, all at G3. Only R4 can be any subject.

structural.label: Five subjects at G3
structural.note: All five subjects counted in L1R4 must be G3.

performance.label: L1R4 of 16 or better, all at G3
performance.note: English, a Humanities, a Maths or Science, one more of either, and one best other. Bonus points (up to 3) affect posting only, not the 16.

performance.label: Grade floors
performance.note: English C6 and a G3 Maths D7. Mother Tongue need not be G3: D7 at G3, 5 at G2 or D at G1 all count.

alsoIn: Direct School Admission takes talent, before results.
